script.hook: Build interactive UIs from simple components
script.tagline: React is a JavaScript library for building web and native user interfaces.

beats.title: Declarative views
beats.body: Design a view for each state and React updates just the right components when data changes.

beats.title: Component-based
beats.body: Build encapsulated components that manage their own state, then compose them into complex UIs.

beats.title: Learn once, write anywhere
beats.body: Render on the server with Node and power mobile apps with React Native.

beats.title: Gradual adoption
beats.body: Use as little or as much React as you need, without rewriting existing code.

script.hook: Edit, build and debug in one open source editor
script.tagline: Code - OSS is the MIT-licensed open source repository behind Visual Studio Code, built with the community.

beats.title: Rich code understanding
beats.body: Comprehensive code editing, navigation and understanding support for your core workflow.

beats.title: Lightweight debugging
beats.body: Debug right inside the editor, with lightweight integration with your existing tools.

beats.title: Extensible by design
beats.body: A rich extensibility model, plus built-in extensions with grammars and snippets for many languages.

beats.title: Runs everywhere
beats.body: Available for Windows, macOS and Linux, updated monthly with new features and bug fixes.

script.hook: Build full-stack web apps on the latest React
script.tagline: Next.js is the React framework for building full-stack web applications.

beats.title: Full-stack React apps
beats.body: Create full-stack web applications by extending the latest React features.

beats.title: Rust-based tooling
beats.body: Integrates powerful Rust-based JavaScript tooling for the fastest builds.

beats.title: Easy to learn
beats.body: Get started with the Learn Next.js course and full docs at nextjs.org/docs.

beats.title: Open source community
beats.body: MIT licensed, with GitHub Discussions and a Discord server to share projects.

script.hook: Style custom UIs fast with utility classes
script.tagline: A utility-first CSS framework for rapidly building custom user interfaces.

beats.title: Utility-first CSS
beats.body: Compose your designs from small utility classes instead of hand-writing stylesheets.

beats.title: Built for custom UIs
beats.body: Designed for rapidly building your own user interfaces, your way.

beats.title: Responsive and PostCSS
beats.body: Works with responsive design and PostCSS, built with TypeScript and Rust.

beats.title: Open source, MIT
beats.body: MIT licensed, with full docs at tailwindcss.com and discussions on GitHub.

script.hook: Run, test, bundle and install JS with one tool
script.tagline: An all-in-one toolkit for JavaScript and TypeScript apps, shipped as a single executable called bun.

beats.title: Drop-in Node.js replacement
beats.body: A fast runtime powered by JavaScriptCore, built to cut startup times and memory usage.

beats.title: TypeScript out of the box
beats.body: Run .ts and .tsx files directly with bun run. TS and JSX work with no extra setup.

beats.title: Built-in test runner
beats.body: bun test runs your tests, with mocks, snapshots and code coverage included.

beats.title: Node-compatible installs
beats.body: bun install adds packages and bunx executes them, in existing Node.js projects with few changes.

code.text:
bun test                      # run tests
bun run start                 # run the `start` script in `package.json`
bun install <pkg>             # install a package
bunx cowsay 'Hello, world!'   # execute a package

script.hook: Run TypeScript directly with secure defaults
script.tagline: Deno is a modern runtime for JavaScript, TypeScript and WebAssembly, built on V8, Rust and Tokio.

beats.title: TypeScript out of the box
beats.body: Write a server.ts file and run it with deno run. JavaScript and WebAssembly work too.

beats.title: Secure by default
beats.body: Programs only get access you grant, like network access via the --allow-net flag.

beats.title: Web server in three lines
beats.body: Deno.serve takes a handler and returns a standard Response, served on localhost:8000.

beats.title: Std library and JSR
beats.body: Officially supported utilities in the Deno Standard Library, plus the open-source JSR registry.

script.tagline: Svelte is a compiler that turns declarative components into efficient JavaScript for web apps.

beats.title: A compiler, not a runtime
beats.body: Svelte compiles your declarative components ahead of time into efficient JavaScript.

beats.title: Surgical DOM updates
beats.body: The generated code updates exactly the parts of the DOM that change.

beats.title: Declarative components
beats.body: Describe your UI with components and let the compiler handle the heavy lifting.

beats.title: Open source, MIT
beats.body: MIT-licensed and built by volunteers, with a public roadmap and Discord chat.

script.hook: Start your dev server instantly, every single time
script.tagline: Vite is a frontend build tool for a faster, leaner dev experience on modern web projects.

beats.title: Instant Server Start
beats.body: A dev server built on native ES modules, with rich feature enhancements out of the box.

beats.title: Lightning Fast HMR
beats.body: Extremely fast Hot Module Replacement keeps your edits in sync as you work.

beats.title: Optimized Builds
beats.body: A build command that bundles with Rolldown into highly optimized static assets.

beats.title: Fully Typed Plugins
beats.body: Extend Vite through its Plugin API and JavaScript API, both with full typing support.

script.hook: Get Postgres, auth, APIs and storage in one place
script.tagline: Supabase is the open source Postgres development platform with Firebase-like features.

beats.title: Dedicated Postgres database
beats.body: Hosted Postgres for web, mobile and AI apps. Self-host or develop locally too.

beats.title: Auto-generated APIs
beats.body: REST and GraphQL APIs from your database, plus realtime subscriptions over websockets.

beats.title: Auth and storage built in
beats.body: JWT-based sign-ups, logins and sessions, plus file storage with Postgres permissions.

beats.title: Functions and AI toolkit
beats.body: Run database and edge functions, and build AI features with the vector toolkit.

script.hook: Own every line of your UI components
script.tagline: Beautifully designed, accessible components you customize, extend and build your own library on.

beats.title: Open Code
beats.body: The component code is yours to read, customize and extend. Start here, then make it your own.

beats.title: Accessible by Default
beats.body: Composable, accessible components with thoughtful defaults built in.

beats.title: Your Own Library
beats.body: Use it as the foundation to build your own component library.

beats.title: MIT Licensed
beats.body: Open source under the MIT license, written in TypeScript.

script.hook: Build fast software without memory bugs
script.tagline: The compiler, standard library and docs for Rust, a language for reliable and efficient software.

beats.title: Fast and memory-efficient
beats.body: Suited to critical services and embedded devices, and easy to integrate with other languages.

beats.title: Safety at compile time
beats.body: A rich type system and ownership model ensure memory and thread safety before your code runs.

beats.title: Helpful diagnostics
beats.body: A compiler committed to great error messages, backed by comprehensive documentation.

beats.title: Tooling included
beats.body: Cargo for builds and packages, rustfmt, Clippy and rust-analyzer for editor support.

script.hook: Add types to JavaScript without leaving JavaScript
script.tagline: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds optional types and compiles to clean JavaScript.

beats.title: Optional static types
beats.body: Add types where you want them to power tooling for large-scale JavaScript applications.

beats.title: Readable JavaScript output
beats.body: Compiles to readable, standards-based JavaScript you can ship anywhere.

beats.title: Any browser, host or OS
beats.body: Built for application-scale JavaScript that runs in any browser, on any host, on any OS.

beats.title: Stable or nightly
beats.body: Install the latest stable release, or try nightly builds with typescript@next.

script.tagline: Go is an open source programming language that makes it easy to build simple, reliable, efficient software.

beats.title: Simple and reliable
beats.body: A language designed to make building simple, reliable and efficient software easy.

beats.title: Official binaries
beats.body: Download official binary distributions from go.dev/dl and follow the install guide.

beats.title: Build from source
beats.body: No binary for your OS and architecture? Install from source with the official instructions.

beats.title: Open source, BSD licensed
beats.body: Distributed under a BSD-style license and built by thousands of contributors.

script.hook: Hack on the code that runs your hardware
script.tagline: The Linux kernel source tree: the core that manages hardware and resources for every Linux OS.

beats.title: Runs your hardware
beats.body: Handles hardware, system resources and the core services all other software relies on.

beats.title: Docs for every role
beats.body: Guides for new developers, researchers, security experts, sysadmins, maintainers and vendors.

beats.title: Internals explained
beats.body: Read up on memory management, the scheduler, networking, filesystems, RCU and locking.

beats.title: Open community
beats.body: Report bugs, send your first patch and join discussions on lore.kernel.org and IRC.

script.hook: Ship your web app as a tiny native desktop app
script.tagline: A Rust framework for building small, fast desktop and mobile apps with any web frontend.

beats.title: Any web frontend
beats.body: Use any framework that compiles to HTML, JS and CSS, backed by a Rust binary with an API.

beats.title: Desktop and mobile
beats.body: Target Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android using the system webview.

beats.title: Built-in bundler
beats.body: Produce .app, .dmg, .deb, .rpm, .AppImage, .exe and .msi bundles out of the box.

beats.title: Native extras included
beats.body: Self updater on desktop, system tray icons, native notifications and no localhost server.

script.hook: Run JavaScript outside the browser, on any platform
script.tagline: Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment.

beats.title: Long Term Support lines
beats.body: Every major version becomes LTS with 30 months of support, 36 months in total.

beats.title: Predictable release cadence
beats.body: Follows semver, with a new major each April and Alpha lines for library authors.

beats.title: Verifiable binaries
beats.body: Check downloads against SHA checksums and releaser PGP signatures.

beats.title: Open governance
beats.body: Run under an open governance model with support from the OpenJS Foundation.
